hero.title: Advanced Cardiology Services
hero.subtitle: World-class heart care blending cutting-edge clinical technology with compassionate, patient-centered healing environments.

sectionHeader.title: Specialized Care Areas
sectionHeader.subtitle: Comprehensive treatment options tailored to every aspect of heart health.

items.title: Heart Failure Management
items.text: Comprehensive, long-term care plans focusing on improving quality of life and managing symptoms effectively.

items.title: Interventional Cardiology
items.text: Minimally invasive procedures including angioplasty and stenting to treat coronary artery disease.

items.title: Electrophysiology
items.text: Diagnosis and treatment of heart rhythm disorders (arrhythmias) using advanced mapping and ablation techniques.

items.title: Preventive Cardiology
items.text: Proactive risk assessment, lifestyle coaching, and medical management to prevent cardiovascular events before they occur.

items.title: Pediatric Cardiology
items.text: Compassionate heart care for infants, children, and adolescents with congenital or acquired heart conditions.

items.title: Cardiovascular Rehabilitation
items.text: Structured exercise and education programs designed to help patients recover and improve heart health after surgery or a cardiac event.
